trio_presentation.title: Musical excellence at the service of your emotions
trio_presentation.p1: We are Trio Euterpe, a chamber ensemble composed of professional musicians with extensive experience and training in the most prestigious conservatories.
trio_presentation.p2: Our passion is to bring the elegance and emotion of live music to the most important moments of your life. From the majesty of classical music to the latest soundtracks and pop covers.
trio_presentation.p3: We work on every acoustic, aesthetic, and emotional detail to offer a warm, elegant, and completely tailored sound. Every event is unique, and our music adapts to you to create unforgettable memories.

bento_gallery.title: The Visual Soundtrack
bento_gallery.desc: A glimpse of some of the celebrations where our harmony has accompanied unique moments.

testimonials.title: Echoes & Resonances
testimonials.desc: Our greatest satisfaction is knowing that our performance has left a lasting impression.
testimonials.text_1: They made our ceremony something magical. The bride's entrance with Pachelbel's Canon performed by them was spectacular. Absolutely recommended.
testimonials.text_2: We hired Trio Euterpe for the cocktail hour and it was a total success. They have a modern repertoire adapted to a classical style that left all the guests amazed.
testimonials.text_3: Professionalism from the very first minute. They helped us choose every piece for our civil wedding and the result was super emotional. Thank you so much.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: We answer the most common questions about our services.
faq.q1: Do you bring your own amplification equipment?
faq.a1: Yes, we have our own high-quality professional sound equipment. We adapt to the acoustic needs of each space to ensure the music sounds perfect, whether in churches or open estates.
faq.a2: Of course. We have a lot of experience playing outdoors. We just need to make sure we have a small shaded area (in the height of summer) and access to a nearby power outlet for our sound equipment.
faq.q3: Can we request a song that is not in the repertoire?
faq.a3: Absolutely! We understand there are songs with very special sentimental value. If you give us enough notice, we can arrange and prepare practically any song exclusively for you.
faq.q4: How far in advance should we book?
faq.a4: We recommend booking at least 6-8 months in advance, especially if you are getting married in high season (May to October). However, you can always check our availability just in case your date is free.

final_cta.title: Ready to put a soundtrack to your event?
final_cta.desc: Let's talk with no obligation. Tell us what you have in mind and we will take care of creating the perfect musical atmosphere.

ceremonies.hero_subtitle: The perfect soundtrack for your "I do"
ceremonies.intro_text: We understand that the ceremony is the emotional core of your wedding. Whether under the solemnity of a temple or the warmth of an outdoor civil space, we adapt our performance so that every note reflects your personality and moves every guest.

coctel.intro_title: The art of breaking the ice
coctel.intro_p1: The cocktail hour or welcome drinks mark the first relaxed moment of your celebration. Our goal is to create an elegant and laid-back atmosphere where guests can comfortably chat while enjoying an exquisite soundtrack.
coctel.intro_p2: From acoustic arrangements of your favorite pop/rock songs to jazz classics that never go out of style. A dynamic repertoire that will surprise and captivate in equal parts.

otros_eventos.hero_subtitle: Classical music concerts, soundtracks, and corporate events
otros_eventos.intro_p1: The talent and versatility of Trio Euterpe allows us to cover much more than wedding ceremonies. As active professional musicians, we have taken our music to auditoriums, theaters, and exclusive events.
otros_eventos.intro_p2: We offer themed concert cycles, from purely classical recitals (exploring works from the Baroque to the Romantic period) to spectacular monographics dedicated to the most awarded film music composers (Hans Zimmer, John Williams, Ennio Morricone).
otros_eventos.card_1_desc: Auditoriums, theaters, and solemn institutional events.
otros_eventos.card_2_desc: Immersive concerts dedicated to the magic of the seventh art.
